verdict.rationale: Riveter is a hosted API, and its marketing says it "reads PDFs and images" and can turn a URL into parseable text, so PDF text extraction without self-hosting is plausibly covered. The evidence never mentions Word, Excel or PowerPoint, and there is no dedicated document-extraction endpoint or docs on extraction quality. Missing for 10: Word/DOCX extraction, Excel/XLSX extraction, PowerPoint/PPTX extraction, a documented file-upload or document-parsing endpoint, extraction-quality details, independent corroboration.
